reason: pi2dsh is a compatibility bridge that lets unmodified Pi ecosystem plugins run as native DeepSeek Harness plugins through the Pi extension ABI and DSH services.

summaries.zh: pi2dsh 将 Pi 生态插件的扩展 ABI 桥接到 DeepSeek Harness，使未修改的 Pi 插件能够作为 DSH 插件安装和运行。
summaries.en: pi2dsh bridges the Pi extension ABI to DeepSeek Harness so unmodified Pi ecosystem plugins can be installed and run as DSH plugins.

capabilities: Loads and mounts Pi ecosystem npm plugins as DeepSeek Harness plugins
Provides a compatibility layer implementing the Pi extension ABI over DSH services
Exposes bridged plugin tools, sessions, model providers, UI surfaces, and external integrations
Can support plugin features involving credentials, network services, image processing, MCP calls, and subagents
